findings.message: 7 eyebrow/kicker label(s) above headings: "Il problema" (pill) above "Ogni pianta ha le sue esigenze"; "Come funziona" (pill) above "Da dove parte l'app"; "Con o senza sensore" (pill) above "Sensori: il prossimo passo"; "Funzionalità" (pill) above "Le funzioni in progetto"; "Piani" (pill) above "Gratuito e Plus: la proposta"
findings.fix: Delete them. If the label carried real information, fold it into the headline or the supporting sentence.

findings.message: 7 tiny uppercase letter-spaced labels (e.g. "Il problema", "Come funziona", "Con o senza sensore", "Funzionalità").
findings.fix: Use sentence-case text at a readable size, or delete the label.

findings.message: 2 gradient fill(s): span.blob.blob-a → radial-gradient(circle at 40% 40%, rgb(225, 234, 217), rgba(0, 0, 0, 0) 68%) | span.blob.blob-b → radial-gradient(circle at 40% 40%, rgb(225, 234, 217), rgba(0, 0, 0, 0) 68%)
findings.fix: Use a flat colour or a real image. The only gradient allowed by default is a neutral scrim over a photo for legibility.

findings.message: 6 box-shadow(s) on elements at rest: li.step.is-in → rgba(36, 79, 61, 0.18) 0px 10px 30px -12px | li.step.is-in → rgba(36, 79, 61, 0.18) 0px 10px 30px -12px | li.step.is-in → rgba(36, 79, 61, 0.18) 0px 10px 30px -12px
findings.fix: Remove. Separate surfaces with a tone step or space. Shadows are for things that really float (menus, dialogs, sticky bars).
Delete. Separate with space, a tone change, or scale. Lines are only for real tables and form fields.
Define a surface by its fill (one tone step from the page) or leave the content unboxed.

findings.message: 2 row(s) of identical cards each topped with a small icon (3, 6 cards).
findings.fix: Replace with one composed section from the direction: a narrative split, a list set in large type, or real imagery per item.
A page needs about five: display, heading, lead, body, small.

findings.message: Only 1 picture(s) on the page (0 photographs, footage or raster images, 1 interface fragments). Drawings in SVG do not count.
findings.fix: Find real pictures of the subject's world with scripts/assets.mjs (photographs, archival images, maps, engravings, footage), download them to assets/ and give them room: a hero picture, one per section that has a subject, a full-width band. At least four, usually six to twelve.

findings.message: No video anywhere on the page.
findings.fix: Look for one honest clip with scripts/assets.mjs --video (the place, the material, the process) and use it as a muted loop with a poster frame. Defend its absence only if no clip fits the subject.
Nothing meant to be read goes below 13px.

findings.message: The margins differ: 180px on the left, 209px on the right, at 1440px.
findings.fix: Put the navigation and the content on one pair of margins; check for padding on one side only, a scrollbar gutter, or a header on another inset than the page.

findings.message: Large text lies under another element at some scroll position: "Le tue piante, sotto controllo" (screen 1, 100% hidden)
findings.fix: Nothing may sit on top of a headline or statement. Move the picture, shorten the pinned run, or raise the text above it (z-index) and give it a ground.

findings.message: Pinned large text slides across pictures while the page scrolls: "Le tue piante, sotto controllo" (screen 1, 100% over a picture)
findings.fix: Jurors read a pinned title crossing drawings or photographs as a collision. Keep the pictures in the column the title does not occupy, or unpin it.

findings.message: 5 of 12 desktop screens are almost empty ground (under 20% of the screen holds text, a picture or a colour field): screens 1, 2, 3, 4, 5.
findings.fix: An empty screen is a rest only once per page. Elsewhere it means the section is underbuilt: set its content larger, give it the full information, put it on a colour field, or cut it.

findings.message: 1 row(s) scroll sideways with content past their edge.
findings.fix: Jurors and most visitors read a row cut at the edge as clipped, not as scrollable. Wrap it onto more lines, or end it inside the grid.
